definitions.gloss: business world; commercial circles; the world of commerce
definitions.explanation: The sphere of commercial and business activity, or the people and organizations within it. A formal term used in news, writing, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {商界|しょうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: He achieved success in the business world.

examples.japanese: {商界|しょうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大物|おおもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was invited to a party where big names in the business world gather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{商界|しょうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じて→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、わずか{十年|じゅうねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{財|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}した。
examples.english: She made her fortune within just ten years of entering the business world.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{商|しょう}→商：26727_shou⟧ ('commerce; trade') and ⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧ ('world; sphere'). Follows the same pattern as other {〜界|かい} compounds: ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧ ('political world'), ⟦{財界|ざいかい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧ ('financial world'), {学界|がっかい} ('academic world').

USAGE:
- A written, formal term — in casual speech, {ビジネスの世界|せかい} is more natural
- Often appears in biographies, news articles, and business reporting
- Can refer to either the abstract sphere of business or collectively to business people

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商界|しょうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大物|おおもの}: big figure in the business world
- {商界|しょうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the business world
- {商界|しょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to retire from the business world
- {商界|しょうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧: trends in the business world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財界|ざいかい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧: financial world — focuses on the financial and industrial establishment
- {実業界|じつぎょうかい}: business world; industrial circles — broader, includes manufacturing and industry
- ⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧: business — loanword used in everyday conversation, less formal
